_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Quad-then-quintuple feature Tuesday — OpenAI closes $122B at $852B post-money (largest private round ever, late-2026 IPO base case, 900M weekly ChatGPT users, enterprise >40% of revenue), Salesforce reframes Slack as agentic OS (30 Slackbot AI features + Slack MCP server GA + Anthropic Claude back end), OpenAI counters with Workspace Agents (custom-GPT successor plugging into Slack/Salesforce), Anthropic signs first government-level AI safety MOU outside US/UK with Australia (AUD$3M research partnerships, Sydney 4th Asia-Pacific office, data-centre exploration). Late-evening Pacific the Claude Code v2.1.88 npm publish ships a 59.8MB source map with ~513K lines / ~1,900 files of unobfuscated TypeScript — the full client-side agent harness in the wild — overshadowing the rest of the cycle by Wednesday morning. Research wave (HF Papers / arXiv) pivots from Sunday's agent-protocol governance to multi-agent civilisation infrastructure (EpochX persistent-state MAS, Emergent Social Intelligence Risks in MAS, Marco DeepResearch verification-centric design, Towards a Medical AI Scientist, MuSEAgent stateful experiences) plus inference-stack mechanisms (Kernel-Smith LLM-driven evolutionary GPU kernel optimisation, TAPS task-aware speculative decoding, HISA hierarchical sparse attention). Blogs: Simon Willison on Axios npm supply-chain attack (101M weekly downloads, second canonical data point after LiteLLM .pth) and Stratechery's Apple-50-years-of-integration question. New topic 'agent-supply-chain-security' spawns from the Axios + Claude Code source-publish + LiteLLM convergence; new topic 'multi-agent-civilisation' spawns from EpochX + MuSEAgent + Emergent Social Risks cohort. Slow EMAs hold the consolidating cohort firmly above the 30 gate; multiple fast EMAs surge above slow on the news-heavy day (mcp-adoption, lab-services-gtm, agent-platforms-enterprise, ai-governance, ai-coding-agents).
